Migration_HowITunes: In Apple Music, choose File > Library > Export Library. In iTunes for Windows, choose Edit > Preferences > Advanced and turn on "Share iTunes Library XML with other applications". Then choose the library file.
Migration_HowMusicBee: In MusicBee, open Edit > Preferences > Library and turn on "Save a copy of the library tags as an iTunes formatted XML file". Close MusicBee, then choose the file "iTunes Music Library.xml" in MusicBee's library folder.
Migration_HowPlaylistFiles: Choose one or more playlist files. The music they list must be on this computer.

Wizard_ImportBody: Already have your music somewhere else? No problem! Choose the folder it's in, and rpm reads it, checks it and files it neatly into your collection.
Wizard_LayoutBody: Pick the view your library opens in. You can switch between them any time, at the top of the library.
Wizard_LayoutListDesc: Each album with its cover and its tracklist.
Wizard_LayoutTableDesc: Every song in rows and columns, to sort and edit.
Wizard_LayoutTitle: How do you want to browse your collection?
Wizard_LayoutWallDesc: Every cover side by side, like your records on a shelf.
Wizard_LookBackgroundHint: The picture behind the whole app. You can also use one of your own later, in Settings.
Wizard_RegionBody: Choose the language the app should be in, and your country for localization.
Wizard_SupportPitch: rpm is made by a small team of people who love music, and who believe in collecting and owning your own. Supporters help keep it going: they cover the hosting costs and help us build new features.
Wizard_TryStarterHint: No music to hand? No problem! Start with three tracks from us and see what rpm can do.
